## 🎨 Proposed Template Name
e.g., `creative-sidebar`, `medical-cv`, `legal-brief`, `academic-ieee`

## 🎯 Target Document Category
- [ ] CV / Resume (ATS-friendly)
- [ ] Technical Specification / RFC
- [ ] Portfolio / Case Study
- [ ] Academic Paper / Thesis
- [ ] Business Proposal / Executive Summary
- [ ] Other: [Specify]

## 📐 Typographic & Layout Specifications
- **Primary Body Font**: (e.g. Arial, Times New Roman, Inter, JetBrains Mono)
- **Heading Fonts**: (e.g. Garamond, Montserrat, Calibri)
- **Primary / Accent Color**: (e.g. Emerald `#10b981`, Indigo `#6366f1`)
- **Page Margins**: (e.g. 1 inch standard, 0.75 inch compact)
- **Special Elements**: (e.g. Sidebars, badges, multi-column metrics, callout blocks)

## 📸 Visual References / Inspiration
Link to examples, screenshots, or design mockups if available.
